summary: VanEck Solana ETF (VSOL, Nasdaq) filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing an ordinary quarterly cash distribution funded from staking income, not a special situation. The Sponsor, VanEck Digital Assets LLC, declared a first distribution totaling $964,960 to holders of record October 6, 2026, payable October 7, 2026, with shares trading ex-dividend October 6, 2026. The Trust may sell staking rewards or a portion of its SOL to fund payouts, potentially altering SOL exposure, market price, or NAV. Quarterly distributions are intended to preserve grantor-trust safe-harbor treatment under IRS Revenue Procedure 2025-31. No deal terms, premiums, or closing conditions apply; no arbitrage angle exists.
